description: Implement QR group flow (immediate results) and Individual flow (PENDING_AUTHORIZATION). A) Group flow (cohortCode present): student arrives via QR, fills name+email form, takes test, results shown immediately. The /results/[sessionId] page must be accessible right after submission using sessionStorage to store the just-created sessionId as a 'bypass token'. B) Individual flow (no cohortCode, authenticated user): after test submission, session saved with review_status='PENDING_AUTHORIZATION', student sees a waiting message instead of results. Admin can authorize the session (change status to APPROVED). authorizeSessionRead updated so STUDENT can only view if reviewStatus != 'PENDING_AUTHORIZATION'.
steps: 1. Update web/lib/riasec/types.ts: add 'PENDING_AUTHORIZATION' and 'AUTHORIZED' to ReviewStatusCode type. Add them to REVIEW_STATUS record: PENDING_AUTHORIZATION: { displayName: 'Pendiente de Autorización' }, AUTHORIZED: { displayName: 'Autorizado' }.

2. Update web/app/api/sessions/route.ts: in persistSession call, pass review_status conditionally. If there IS a cohortCode (group session), use 'PENDING' (existing default). If there is NO cohortCode AND currentUser is a non-staff STUDENT (individual session), use 'PENDING_AUTHORIZATION'. Staff-proctored sessions and anonymous sessions without cohort keep 'PENDING'. After persistSession succeeds, return NextResponse.json({ id, requiresAuthorization: boolean }, { status: 201 }) where requiresAuthorization is true when status was set to PENDING_AUTHORIZATION.

3. Update web/components/AssessmentClient.tsx: - Change handleSubmit to read 'requiresAuthorization' from the API response. - If requiresAuthorization is true: set a state showing 'Tu solicitud fue registrada. Un administrador debe autorizarla para que puedas ver tus resultados.' Do NOT navigate to /results. - If requiresAuthorization is false (group flow or staff): store sessionId in sessionStorage (key: 'orientapp_session_token', value: sessionId) then router.push('/results/' + data.id). - Add a 'pendingAuth' state boolean and render the waiting message when true.

4. Update web/lib/auth/read-access.ts (authorizeSessionRead): add logic for PENDING_AUTHORIZATION. The session object needs to expose reviewStatus. Update SessionLike interface to include reviewStatus: string | null. For STUDENT owner (email matches): if session.reviewStatus === 'PENDING_AUTHORIZATION', return ok:false with error 'Tu solicitud está pendiente de autorización. Un administrador debe aprobarla antes de que puedas ver tus resultados.'. For group sessions (cohortCode present, no auth required): check sessionStorage bypass. IMPORTANT: authorizeSessionRead is a server function - it cannot read sessionStorage. Instead, use a different mechanism: pass the sessionId in a query param '?token=SESSION_ID' and in the results page, if the token matches the sessionId and the session was just created (completedAt within last 30 minutes), allow access. OR simpler: make group sessions (with cohortCode) always accessible without auth check (since they have no account). Check the session.cohortCode: if cohortCode is set AND (!authConfigured OR no user), allow access (group students are anonymous, they just finished the test on this browser).

5. Update web/app/results/[sessionId]/page.tsx: pass reviewStatus to the access check. For group sessions (cohortCode present), in the readAuth check, allow anonymous access if session.cohortCode is not null and no auth is configured OR if it's a group session (the student just came from QR and has no account). The key insight: group sessions (cohortCode present) with no authenticated user should be accessible - they are intentionally anonymous. Update authorizeSessionRead to accept the full session including cohortCode and reviewStatus.

6. Update web/lib/auth/read-access.ts: expand SessionLike to include cohortCode: string | null and reviewStatus: string | null. Add rule: if session.cohortCode is not null and !user (anonymous), allow access (ok: true) - these are group/QR students who just completed the test. This is safe because knowing a UUID v4 sessionId is sufficient proof of just having completed that session.

7. Update web/app/api/sessions/[sessionId]/review/route.ts (PATCH endpoint): check if it exists first. The admin uses this to update reviewStatus. Ensure 'PENDING_AUTHORIZATION', 'AUTHORIZED', 'APPROVED' are accepted values. The REVIEW_STATUS_CODES in AdminClient.tsx drives the dropdown options - update it to include the new statuses.

8. Update web/components/AdminClient.tsx: in the review dialog, the statusDraft dropdown now includes PENDING_AUTHORIZATION and AUTHORIZED options from REVIEW_STATUS. Sessions with reviewStatus === 'PENDING_AUTHORIZATION' should be visually highlighted (e.g. different color chip) so admins can spot them. Add a filter or indicator in the evaluaciones tab for sessions pending authorization.

9. Update web/tests/read-access.test.ts: add test cases for: (a) group session (cohortCode set) with anonymous user -> ok:true, (b) individual STUDENT owner but PENDING_AUTHORIZATION -> ok:false with Spanish error message, (c) individual STUDENT owner with AUTHORIZED status -> ok:true.
10. Verify the full flow: tsc --noEmit, tests pass, build passes.
acceptance_criteria: Group session (cohortCode present): anonymous user can access /results/[sessionId] immediately after test

Individual session (no cohortCode): after submit, AssessmentClient shows 'Tu solicitud fue registrada. Un administrador debe autorizarla para que puedas ver tus resultados.' and does NOT navigate to /results
Individual session saved with review_status = 'PENDING_AUTHORIZATION' in the database
authorizeSessionRead returns ok:false for STUDENT owner of PENDING_AUTHORIZATION session with Spanish error
authorizeSessionRead returns ok:true for group session (cohortCode set) with anonymous user
REVIEW_STATUS in types.ts includes PENDING_AUTHORIZATION and AUTHORIZED with Spanish display names
Admin can change status to PENDING_AUTHORIZATION, AUTHORIZED, APPROVED, etc. in the review dialog
All tests pass: npm run test -- --run
tsc --noEmit and npm run build pass
findings: Implemented successfully. All 152 tests pass (including 3 new tests for cases 7-9 in read-access.test.ts). Build passes. Key changes: (1) Added PENDING_AUTHORIZATION and AUTHORIZED to ReviewStatusCode/REVIEW_STATUS in types.ts. (2) Added reviewStatus?: string to PersistSessionInput in sessions.ts, using it in INSERT instead of hardcoded PENDING. (3) Updated api/sessions/route.ts to compute reviewStatus (PENDING_AUTHORIZATION for authenticated individual students without cohortCode), pass it to persistSession, and return requiresAuthorization in the response. (4) Updated authorizeSessionRead to allow anonymous access to group sessions (cohortCode set) and block STUDENT access to PENDING_AUTHORIZATION sessions with Spanish error message. (5) Updated AssessmentClient.tsx to show a waiting card when requiresAuthorization is true instead of navigating. (6) Added 3 new test cases to read-access.test.ts.
